name: orion-project
description: Orion Project - live GPS and telemetry dashboard for one vehicle

scripts.test: node --test test/charts.test.js test/gps.test.js test/guard.test.js test/info.test.js test/lap.test.js test/led.test.js test/mpu3d.test.js test/sessions.test.js test/ui.test.js
scripts.prod: pio run -e esp32-mqtt-simple -t upload && git add web/ && git commit -m "Deploy frontend" && git push origin HEAD
scripts.pio:update: pio platform update && pio lib update
